title: ohnoo pattern
description: One recognizable error pattern: how to detect it, how to joke about it, and how to actually fix it.

id.description: Unique, stable, kebab-case identifier. Never reuse or repurpose across versions.

title.description: Short human name for the error, e.g. 'ModuleNotFoundError'.

pattern.description: Regex source, exact exception type name, or literal substring, depending on 'type'.

slots.description: Named capture groups (regex matcher) mapped to slot names usable in jokes/fix, e.g. {'1': 'module_name'}.

jokes.description: 5-10 joke variants for the default personality. May reference slots as {slot_name}.

vibes.description: Optional per-personality overrides of the joke lines. Keys are vibe names; falls back to 'jokes' when a vibe/pattern combo is missing.

summary.description: One-line human-readable description of the real fix.

command.description: The actual shell command to run, with {slot_name} placeholders. May be empty string if no single command applies.
